name: WiVRn server
tagline: Play your PC VR games on a standalone headset
blurb: WiVRn allows you to run your VR games from your PC and play them from a standalone headset.
description:
WiVRn allows you to run your VR games from your PC and play them from a standalone headset.

Works with the WiVRn client app on standalone headsets, available as an APK and on the Meta Store.

Features:

• Supports OpenXR and OpenVR applications through xrizer or OpenComposite

• Controller tracking, hand tracking, eye gaze tracking, body tracking as supported by the headset

• Audio streaming and microphone

• Low latency video streaming with H264 / HEVC / AV1 compression

• Hardware accelerated compression with Vulkan video encode, VAAPI or NVENC

• Software compression with x264

Supported headsets:

• Meta Quest 1, 2, 3, 3S, pro

• Pico Neo 4

• HTC Vive Focus 3, XR Elite

• Samsung Galaxy XR

For desktop streaming, check out WayVR.
developer: Guillaume Meunier, Patrick Nicolas et al

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
